label: three_state_jones_and_oxford_scalar_orientation_contract_v2
purpose: Separate the full Jones response required for the Chomaz-informed BEC, SSP and ID comparison from the scalar perpendicular-eigenmode response retained for the Oxford TFBEC multiframe study.

three_state_equilibrium.consumer_scope: BEC, SSP and ID single-exposure comparisons of PCI, DGI, DFFI and DPFI; the three density objects are independent and state_feedback remains none.

source_geometry.reported_density_information: The source fixes the axial line-density morphology n(y); it does not provide the transverse widths used by the thesis analytic y-z column-density objects.

source_to_thesis_axis_mapping.density_array_consequence: The y coordinate and source axial line density are unchanged. The thesis-controlled transverse z widths remain unchanged, so the existing BEC, SSP and ID y-z arrays do not require numerical rotation or resampling.
source_to_thesis_axis_mapping.physical_boundary: This is a global right-handed relabelling of the source geometry, not a rotation of B relative to a fixed cloud. The source absorption technique and time-of-flight expansion are not imported into the thesis imaging model.

jones_atomic_response.model_status: ideal isolated-401-nm-line, fully polarised, weak-probe, common-detuning Jones response; not a calibrated multilevel apparatus response

detuning_convention.detuning_hz: the common-detuning value is probe frequency minus the midpoint reference of the two driven branch frequencies; explicit branch detunings, when supplied, are probe frequency minus each branch frequency, in cycles per second
detuning_convention.exact_branch_detunings: Optional absolute probe-minus-branch-transition detunings may be supplied to the Jones response; otherwise both circular branches use the stated common detuning.

branches.label: sigma_minus
branches.closure_status: cycling within the selected J=6 to J'=7 manifold; metastable leakage is excluded

branches.label: pi
branches.closure_status: absent from the transverse input field when k is parallel to B

branches.label: sigma_plus
branches.closure_status: weak non-cycling branch within the selected manifold

field_definition.circular_eigen_transmissions: t_q = exp[-OD_2L*s_q/2 + i*phi_2L*s_q], with s_minus=1 and s_plus=1/91
field_definition.weighting_boundary: The full line strengths belong in t_minus and t_plus. The one-half incident-power fractions enter scattering and the circular-to-linear field projection; they are not multiplied into each eigen-transmission exponent.

scattering_definition.continuity: The branch-summed single-pulse scattering and recoil calculation is unchanged because it already uses the same incident power fractions and line strengths.

must_be_regenerated: three-state PCI and DGI mean camera images
three-state PCI and DGI noisy camera images
three-state axial profiles and apparent contrast
may_be_reused: BEC, SSP and ID analytic y-z column-density arrays
branch-summed single-pulse scattering and recoil values
downstream_correction.legacy_boundary: Existing retained three-state camera and fit payloads preserve their historical provenance but must not support the corrected B-parallel-k comparison. No payload is silently overwritten.

oxford_tfbec.consumer_scope: Oxford partially condensed smooth-TFBEC repeated-equilibrium-endpoint calculations only; it is not used for the four-method three-state comparison.
oxford_tfbec.preservation_boundary: The Oxford scalar optical response, branch-summed recoil, equilibrium update and admitted Chapter 4-5 multiframe results are unchanged by the three-state Jones correction.

consumer_policy.mixed_scalar_contract_forbidden: The three-state Jones response must not be replaced by exp[-OD_c/2+i*phi_c], and the Oxford scalar branch must not be promoted to a Faraday signal.
consumer_policy.three_state_propagation_rule: Without an output analyser, propagate the co-polarised and Faraday-orthogonal atom-dependent complex fields separately through the appropriate optical operator and add their camera intensities. Never propagate total_intensity_fraction as a complex field.
consumer_policy.result_lifecycle: This file is a physics/configuration contract only. It admits no numerical result and authorises no overwrite of retained evidence.
